calls.video_title: Serve Robotics Should Only Be Considered by Investors With a High Risk Tolerance
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated in his words (first tracked call; he says he upgraded it to a buying opportunity on 25 Aug, low conviction then and now; no prior tracked call, so no flip) — Serve Robotics, high-risk/high-reward only for investors with very high risk tolerance. Despite the Uber partnership ending, 2026 revenue guide cut $26M to $9-10M and the stock down >30% in a month / ~70% YTD, he cites 59% upside to his fair value over 12-18 months (transcript price figures garbled/inconsistent), a DoorDash expansion and the Beacon countertop device; he is considering selling puts or buying after a likely dilution announcement.
calls.bull_case: New delivery partnerships (DoorDash/Grubhub/direct restaurant deals) and Beacon integrations replace Uber volume and robot delivery lowers restaurant delivery costs.
calls.bear_case: Likely share dilution in coming quarters/months ($145M 2026 opex vs ~$10M revenue, $235M cash), and failure to win merchant volume without Uber.
